description: The associate runs API, reached on the loopback of the machine that holds the dedicated checkout: http.call runs where this actor lives. The improvement and fix flows start a run with POST /runs (role admin) and read it with GET /runs/{run_id} (role viewer), so the service token needs the admin role: issue it with associate tokens issue --name <name> --role admin (printed once), store it in grant as ASSOCIATE_BRIDGE_SERVICE_TOKEN and inject it into the engine node's unit. The workflows write 127.0.0.1:8794, associate serve's default loopback address: change it in both workflows if associate's bridge listens elsewhere.
name: associate bridge
